(the record's own a); SOLID TEAL = A135's EXACT axis core (certifiable today — a square at the box's own

box. All of them clear K(a) at the LP's own drop margin EPS_CORE = 0.002 — that is why the LP kept
them. 35 are DROPPED by the exact axis core (so an exact-core row filter deletes them with no verifier
change); 7 clear the exact core too and are caught only by K'. Each label gives the three depths.

l2_p65_101 — level 2 (A38 l2); budget 10 = 11 − 1 conditioned square(s)

polygon core on the support: 38 of 83 columns meet K' (0 meet K(a) — the LP's own filter), carrying dual weight 3.7157 of 10.0000 against slack -3.55e-15; the A135 exact axis core alone removes 35 column(s) / weight 3.3147 — that part is inside the FROZEN certificate schema.
full pool: 3284 of 11388 generated columns meet K' (28.8%); K' vs container: worst excursion +0.00e+00 (0 = inside, no T5-type kill); K' vs K' between conditioned boxes: n/a (one conditioned square)

IN-VITRO LP with the column pool pruned by K' (one re-solve, 240 s cap, warm-started from this record): tau 8.776300 of budget 10 (eta -1.2237), converged False, 305.6 s — tau is below budget but the LP has NOT converged at the cap — a KILL CANDIDATE under the polygon core (A57's `dead_unconverged`), not a kill; a
warm continuation is what would settle it.

slot census (A113), MET (a column can meet several cells, so these do NOT partition the support): BL(0,0) doubly by 5 column(s) w 1.42; TR(0,1) doubly by 6 column(s) w 1.48*; TR(0,2) doubly by 7 column(s) w 2.00*; BR(0,1) doubly by 7 column(s) w 1.95*; BL(0,1) doubly by 30 column(s) w 2.03; TL(0,0) doubly by 5

column(s) w 1.07; TR(0,0) doubly by 11 column(s) w 1.78; BR(0,0) doubly by 9 column(s) w 1.95; BR(0,2) doubly by 7 column(s) w 1.60*; BR(1,0) doubly by 24 column(s) w 2.48; TL(0,1) doubly by 30 column(s) w 2.04; TR(1,0) doubly by 23 column(s) w 1.95 [36 named cells met; * = a conditioned square can reach it too]

slot census, BINNED (each column in exactly one bin — the nearest slot centre; these DO partition): BL(0,0) n=2 w=1.00; TR(0,1) n=2 w=0.52(H); TR(0,2) n=2 w=0.52(H); BR(0,1) n=2 w=0.48(H); BL(0,1) n=3 w=0.44; TL(0,0) n=4 w=1.00; TR(0,0) n=1 w=0.52; BR(0,0) n=1 w=0.48; BR(0,2) n=2 w=0.48(H); BR(1,0) n=7 w=1.00;

BIN RULE: every dual-support column is assigned to EXACTLY ONE bin — the named slot cell whose CENTRE is nearest the column's centre (ties broken by name order), over BL/BR/TL/TR (i,j), i,j < 3. So the bin weights PARTITION the support's total dual weight; they do not double count. The separate 'met' counts below are the geometric

statement (a column can overlap several cells) and are A113's singly/doubly-met census, not a partition. The conditioned square is NOT a dual-support column — the node LP counts only the budget = 11 - #cores OTHER squares — so no bin contains it; a bin a conditioned box can itself reach is marked (H).
lane count (A118): BL(0,0) LANE>=2; BR(0,0) LANE>=2; TR(0,0) LANE>=2; TL(0,0) LANE>=2 [differs from A118's stored record; sampling, see results/lane140.json]

CANDIDATE COVER — re-branch on the occupied slot (A113): A113's re-branching rule: the dual support keeps occupying BL(0,0) (2 column(s) snapped onto the cell, weight 1.00; 5 column(s) meet it, weight 1.42), so branch on it. Cover: (a) some square has its centre in the box of BL(0,0) -- add that box as a second
conditioned square and re-solve at budget-1; (b) no square occupies BL(0,0) -- add the NO-family for BL(0,0), which deletes exactly the columns the LP is leaning on.

what it needs to be a certified leaf: (a) the two children emitted and LP-certified at s0; (b) the NO-family arm needs the occupancy transfer of Lemma B-NO to stay sound on the window; (c) the conditioned-pair gate (cores pairwise disjoint) checked for the first child.

geometry check: 11 squares drawn in panel 2, worst containment excursion -0.00e+00, min pairwise SAT separation +0.00e+00; 0 support column(s) outside the container skipped in panel 1; 42 red-dashed column(s), every one re-verified by an independent SAT at 7³ poses.
